connector.name: Code Context
connector.registryDescription: Local code search for AI coding agents: hybrid search and SQL aggregation over an in-repo index.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package code-context. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the infino-ai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: CX_ROOT
env.description: Repository root to serve. Optional - defaults to the working directory the server is launched in.

env.name: CX_INDEX_DIR
env.description: Where the index lives. Optional - defaults to .infino/ inside the repository root.

env.name: CX_AUTO_SYNC
env.description: Set to 0 to disable the background staleness sync that runs as queries arrive.

env.name: CX_NO_EMBED
env.description: Set (1/true/yes) for keyword-only mode - skip the vector stage entirely.

env.name: CX_NO_RECEIPT
env.description: Set (1/true/yes) to turn off local usage accounting: the per-call receipt on results and the cx usage ledger. Optional - on by default, computed locally, nothing leaves the machine.
